meta.goal: Cross-family Tc descriptor unification: test whether ONE closed-form descriptor predicts Tc across hydride / kagome / classic e-ph superconductor families better than McMillan / Allen-Dynes.
notes: ALL (lambda, omega_log, Tc) rows carry a source. omega_log in KELVIN.

N(E_F) recorded where available but UNITS DIFFER across sources (states/eV/atom vs /cell vs /spin) and N(E_F) is NOT an independent predictor in McMillan/Allen-Dynes/FoM (it enters Tc only through lambda). Therefore N(E_F) is metadata, not a fit variable.
omega_log convention: 1 meV = 11.604 K. Sources reporting meV converted.

Kagome rows: omega_log not directly published as a single number -> marked ESTIMATED (back-solved from Allen-Dynes given published lambda, mu*=0.10, and predicted/exp Tc). Flagged est_omega_log=true; EXCLUDED from the primary residual fit to avoid circularity, reported separately as out-of-family stress test.

Tc used in residual = Tc_calc (the DFT/ab-initio-predicted Tc that goes WITH the calculated lambda/omega_log), because McMillan/AllenDynes/FoM all map (lambda,omega_log)->Tc and must be scored against the Tc that the same calculation produced. Tc_exp listed for reference.
